name: oggi-wholesale-v2-checks
description: Dependencies for the behaviour gates in this directory. See README.md. Deliberately nested here rather than at the repository root: Cloudflare Workers Builds detects a ROOT package.json and would insert an npm install step into the deploy of a live site. A nested one is invisible to it, and node resolves node_modules upward from the script that imports, so `npm install` run in this directory is enough for every gate here. checks/ is already in .assetsignore, so nothing in this directory is ever served.

scripts.test: for f in check_*.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
